hint_fr: Aucun échec ne marche ici — essayez-les, ils échouent tous. Cherchez plutôt un coup calme qui crée une menace que rien ne peut parer. Quelle case votre pion f6 tient-il déjà ?
hint_en: No check works here — try them, they all fail. Look instead for a calm move that creates a threat nothing can stop. Which square does your f6 pawn already control?

claims.note: Exhaustive search: Qh6 is the ONLY mate in 2 and gives no check; after every one of Black's 29 replies Qg7# mates (after ...Kh8, Qf8# too — not the stored reply). The stored ...Qd1 is the counter-attack that looks like a defence and is not.
